$schema_note: Phase 353 Plan 02 Task 1 (OQ-353-1, R-353-C). Four members (model-business, model-finances, protect-assets, design-solution) were added to the job vocabulary rather than forcing a wrong job onto business-model, financial-model, legal-ip and solution-design: the Jev probe measured 19-32 percent confidence with flat distributions on those four against the 16 command-derived jobs, because that vocabulary was built for commands, not sections. These four are section-canon values ONLY in this phase; no command adopts them yet, and adoption is a separate, later decision. secondary_job_id, when declared, is carried into the ruling document's generated Part 2 (methodology sequence) as the second block of the sequence, never dropped.
